name: Charge
notes: Sources: petopia-classic (wow-petopia.com/classic/abilities.php) and petopia-forever (wow-petopia.com/forever/abilities.php) are the SAME SITE (count as one source); they are separate datasets for Classic Era and WoW Forever. Petopia gives no spell IDs; its NPC links point to Wowhead (classic.wowhead.com / wowhead.com/forever).

wowhead-classic and wowhead-forever are the SAME SITE (count as one source). Wowhead DOES have a Forever section (wowhead.com/forever/...). Full Wowhead pages are behind an AWS WAF JS challenge (curl gets HTTP 202, empty body) and WebFetch strips page scripts, so the 'Taught by NPC' listviews could NOT be read. Wowhead data here comes only from nether.wowhead.com tooltip JSON: spell 'Requires level' (recorded as petLevel; TP is not in tooltips, so null) and NPC name/level/classification/primary map zone. Wowhead beast observations therefore have rank=null: they confirm identity, level and elite/rare, NOT which rank the NPC teaches. Classic tooltips carry no 'Rank N' label; the rank for classic spell IDs was assigned by matching required level to the Forever tooltip (which shows 'Rank N') and to Petopia's rank levels.
Wowhead NPC zones were converted from the tooltip's numeric map zone id using standard AreaTable ids (e.g. 491=Razorfen Kraul, 719=Blackfathom Deeps); the tooltip gives only one primary zone.

warcrafttavern = warcrafttavern.com/wow-classic/hunter-pets/ (Classic Era; per-model listing pages plus per-pet pages). No NPC IDs (observations matched to IDs by name). elite/rare set only where the per-pet page shows a 'Class' field (Elite or Rare); omitted otherwise. Looks like an independent dataset (it disagrees with Petopia in places), origin not stated.

warcraft.wiki.gg ability pages give few per-rank values and no beast lists; 'Pet abilities (Classic)' gives only rank-1 level and TP per ability. The old URLs Charge_(Boar) returned 404; the working page is Charge_(boar_pet_ability).

warcraft.wiki.gg Charge (boar pet ability), Classic table: 'At present, there is no mob which can teach Charge (Rank 4).' The table column is just 'Level' (not explicitly pet level). Its TP for rank 5 (25) and rank 6 (29) DIFFER from Petopia classic/forever (21 and 25). Spell IDs only for rank 1 (7371) and rank 6 (27685).

FOREVER-SPECIFIC: Petopia Forever lists Charge 4 as learnable from two NEW NPCs in the new zone 'Riverglades': Young Paletusk (258331, 36-37) and Mature Paletusk (255851, 38-39). In Classic Era (petopia-classic, wiki) no beast teaches Charge 4.

FOREVER-SPECIFIC: attack-power values changed: Forever tooltips/Petopia Forever 66/130/204/294/430/520 vs Classic Era (Petopia classic) 50/100/180/250/390/550. Wowhead Forever tooltip for rank 6 (27685) has no 'Rank N' label. A Blizzard forum thread (search result only, not verified) says Charge rank 6 behaves as a different spell from ranks 1-5.

Level differences: Stonetusk Boar 113 is 7-8 on petopia-classic and warcrafttavern but 5-6 on petopia-forever and both Wowhead tooltips; Elder Mottled Boar 3100 is 8-9 (petopia-classic, warcrafttavern, Wowhead) vs 9-10 (petopia-forever); Rotting Agam'ar 4512 is 28 vs 27-28 (petopia-forever).
Wowhead Forever tooltip gives Dire Mottled Boar (3099) primary map zone id 1637 (Orgrimmar) while classic gives 14 (Durotar) - doubtful, probably spawns near the city edge.
Princess (330), Longsnout (119), Bellygrub (345) are named mobs but Wowhead tooltips classify them as (Normal), not rare/elite.
petopia-classic: Charge 4 is shown with "No known training source".
wowhead-forever npc 258331 (Young Paletusk): tooltip map zone id 16591 (not a Classic zone id; presumably the new Forever zone Riverglades) - zones left empty.
wowhead-forever npc 255851 (Mature Paletusk): tooltip map zone id 16591 (not a Classic zone id; presumably the new Forever zone Riverglades) - zones left empty.
